answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock a separate $100 bond for 30 days before accepting work, with payment disputes resolved by verifiable delivery logs and failed deliveries forfeiting the bond. Whether agents manage a terrace, an orchard, or a grove, spawning 1,000 fake sellers ties up $100,000 rather than creating free access. Honest bonds return, but fraudulent identities lose capital when their failures are proven.
